Frames in the standard library or third-party packages do NOT count. The starting depth before the very first yt-dlp call is 0; thus the first call frame has depth 1, a function it calls has depth 2, and so on. Note: under the pytest harness used here, the global trace function does NOT receive `event=call` for generator-expression frames (`<genexpr>`) even when their source file is in `/testbed/yt_dlp/`; only NAMED Python function frames (`def`-defined functions, including class methods, nested closures, lambdas, and dunder methods) emit call/return events that the trace plugin records. 64:        - `tuple`/`list`:   Branch out and return a list of all matching values.
